method: At each period’s first block (dex-data/state-history height + 1), user_info(time: {period: E}) on the TLA gauge controller for every Votion vault: VP (fixed + boost) × each gauge vote’s bps / 10000, summed per gauge pool. A vault whose last vote is stamped after E is counted as stale (left out). Totals per pool: tla-voting/distributions. Aggregates over Votion’s public vault contracts only.
